code:
import requests, json, time, re
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
eutils="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
def get(url,params,tries=5):
    for k in range(tries):
        r=requests.get(url,params=params,timeout=120)
        try: return r.json()
        except Exception: time.sleep(3)
    raise RuntimeError("fail")
s = get(eutils+"esearch.fcgi", {"db":"clinvar","term":'TANC2[gene]',"retmax":1000,"retmode":"json"})
ids = s["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
rows=[]
for i in range(0,len(ids),200):
    es = get(eutils+"esummary.fcgi", {"db":"clinvar","id":",".join(ids[i:i+200]),"retmode":"json"})
    res=es.get("result",{})
    for uid in res.get("uids",[]):
        d=res[uid]; germ=d.get("germline_classification",{})
        rows.append({"title":d.get("title",""),"obj_type":d.get("obj_type",""),
                     "clinsig":germ.get("description",""),
                     "traits":";".join([t.get("trait_name","") for t in germ.get("trait_set",[])])})
    time.sleep(1.0)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)

def vclass(t):
    if re.search(r"GRCh3[78]", t): return "large CNV / cytogenetic"
    if re.search(r"fs\)", t): return "frameshift"
    if "delins" in t and "Ter" in t: return "delins (truncating)"
    if re.search(r"Ter\)", t): return "nonsense"
    if re.search(r"c\.\d+[+-]\d+[ACGT]>[ACGT]", t): return "splice-site"
    if re.search(r"p\.[A-Z][a-z]{2}\d+[A-Z][a-z]{2}\)", t): return "missense"
    if "=" in t: return "synonymous"
    return "other"

plp = df[df["clinsig"].isin(["Pathogenic","Likely pathogenic","Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"])].copy()
plp["class"]=plp["title"].apply(vclass)
vc=plp["class"].value_counts()
print("Total ClinVar records:", len(df)); print(df["clinsig"].value_counts()); print()
print("P/LP n=%d"%len(plp)); print(vc)
trunc = vc.get("frameshift",0)+vc.get("nonsense",0)+vc.get("splice-site",0)+vc.get("delins (truncating)",0)
small = len(plp)-vc.get("large CNV / cytogenetic",0)
print("\nTruncating share of small P/LP variants: %d/%d = %.1f%%"%(trunc,small,100*trunc/small))
print("\nTraits among P/LP:"); print(plp["traits"].value_counts().head(8))
print("\nVUS fraction: %.1f%%"%(100*(df.clinsig=="Uncertain significance").mean()))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(14,5.5))
order = df["clinsig"].value_counts(); order=order[order.index!=""]
axes[0].barh(order.index[::-1], order.values[::-1], color="#4C72B0")
axes[0].set_xlabel("ClinVar records (n=%d)"%len(df)); axes[0].set_title("TANC2 ClinVar classifications")
for i,v in enumerate(order.values[::-1]): axes[0].text(v+6,i,str(v),va="center",fontsize=9)
axes[1].barh(vc.index[::-1], vc.values[::-1], color="#C44E52")
axes[1].set_xlabel("Pathogenic / likely pathogenic records (n=%d)"%len(plp)); axes[1].set_title("Molecular class of TANC2 P/LP variants")
for i,v in enumerate(vc.values[::-1]): axes[1].text(v+0.4,i,str(v),va="center",fontsize=9)
plt.suptitle("TANC2 (17q23.3) in ClinVar: pathogenic alleles are overwhelmingly truncating", fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
